about: Cell art is judged against the monsters the cell takes once every mod's cells are in: harness_art_order_a gives ogres art on cell 1, harness_art_order_b (loaded after it) lets ogres into cell 1. The art must load with no mod error, not be refused against the list as loaded so far.

steps.name: gnx_scn_art_blocks
steps.why: the ogre block on cell 1 is kept

steps.name: gnx_scn_art_pick
steps.why: the ogre on cell 1 draws the art
